places.name: The Mooring Masts
places.epithet: The only quay in the Union where mast and mooring-ring share a stone
places.text: Tall iron masts along the quay, each crowned with a mooring-ring for skycraft. Sea-going ships tie up below; skycraft moor above; cargo is swung between them on cranes.

places.name: Aurora's Rest
places.epithet: A spilled drink can cost more than a ship
places.text: The navigators' inn, with charts spread across every table, where captains of sea and sky compare winds and lie about routes.

places.name: The Crane Yard
places.text: The great cranes that swing cargo from ship to skycraft and back, and the yard where it waits between them.

places.name: The Harbormaster's House
places.text: Where ships from the western sea make their first landfall in the Union and declare it, including the rare elven vessel out of Thal'vireth.

places.name: The Provision Houses
places.text: Salting, drying and packing houses, which make the preserved provisions Cloudmoor is famous for and the Loom eats a great deal of.

places.name: The Bootmakers' Guildhall
places.epithet: Boots and harness for those who fall for a living
places.text: Cloudmoor's boots and flying-harnesses are famous; this is the hall of the guild that makes them, and keeps the patterns locked up.

places.name: Crane Square
places.text: The square behind the quays, where the Sapphire Road comes in and the hiring-boards for crane-crews hang.

places.name: The High Quay
places.text: The long quay under the mooring-masts, with ships below and skycraft above.

places.name: Cobblers' Row
places.text: The bootmakers' and harness-makers' street, loud with hammers from dawn.

places.name: The Sapphire Road
places.text: The road east through Chadon and Burbotford toward Central District, along which most instruments, glass and flight-gear travel.
